title: Bar Pika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:2, Rabbi Yose, son of Rabbi Bun, says that Bar Pika asked Rabbi a question. Hyman explains that this does not mean Rabbenu HaKadosh: the Jerusalem Talmud sometimes calls any of the Nasiim from Rabbi onward “Rabbi.” Rabbi told him, “Bar Pika still persists in his foolishness.”

notes.text: Hyman explicitly says that Rabbi here does not designate Rabbenu HaKadosh, but reflects the title applied to later Nasiim.
